content.tagline: Korean functional skincare and hair care from a GMP manufacturer in Gimpo
content.descriptor: Enveco Cosmetic manufactures hair care, skincare and functional cosmetics in Gimpo, Korea, and develops products for partner brands (OEM/ODM). ARMING is its own brand: seven MFDS functional skincare products and the Cashmere hair care line.
about: Enveco Cosmetic Co., Ltd. is a Korean cosmetics manufacturer with its own plant and research institute in Gimpo, Gyeonggi-do. The company formulates, produces and packs hair care, scalp care, skincare and body care, as well as functional cosmetics for brightening, wrinkle improvement, UV protection and the relief of hair-loss symptoms. Its research institute has been recognised by the Korea Industrial Technology Association (KOITA) since 2016, and production follows the ISO 22716 cosmetics GMP standard, first certified in 2019.

ARMING is Enveco's own brand, launched in 2020. The name means "being beautiful", and the packaging carries a motif of a traditional Korean window lattice. In January 2026 the brand added a skincare line of seven products. Each of them is a functional cosmetic reported to Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) for two effects: skin brightening (niacinamide 2%) and wrinkle improvement (adenosine 0.04%). The sun cream adds a third: SPF50+ PA++++ UV protection.

Every skincare formula is built on 9.8% centella asiatica leaf water, with peptides, ceramides and retinol, and each product has its own signature component: five forms of hyaluronic acid, a seven-collagen complex, ginseng and centella exosomes, or a multivitamin complex. The ARMING Cashmere hair care line, including a scalp booster with 81% cypress water, completes the range.

For partner brands, Enveco works as an OEM manufacturer (your formula and brand) and an ODM developer (from product planning and formulation to production, quality control and shipping). The company has produced hair care for Korean TV-shopping brands and exports to Southeast Asia, Greater China and other markets.

lines.name: Skin Care
lines.note: Seven MFDS functional products for brightening and wrinkle improvement: toner, emulsion, ampoule, watery cream, collagen cream, eye cream and an SPF50+ PA++++ sun cream. All share 9.8% centella leaf water, niacinamide 2% and adenosine 0.04%.

lines.name: Hair Care
lines.note: The Cashmere line for the scalp and hair: a clinic shampoo on coconut-derived surfactants, a weakly acidic treatment, a scalp booster with 81% cypress water, a damage-care hair pack and a leave-in balm essence.

lines.name: OEM / ODM
lines.note: Contract manufacturing under the client's brand: hair and scalp care, functional cosmetics (brightening, anti-wrinkle, UV protection, hair-loss symptom relief), hair colour, skincare and body care.

tech.name: Dual-function base
tech.note: Niacinamide 2% for brightening and adenosine 0.04% for wrinkle improvement, in the doses set by the MFDS functional-cosmetic standard, in all seven skincare products.

tech.name: Cica foundation
tech.note: Centella asiatica leaf water at 9.8% replaces part of the water phase in every skincare formula, together with peptides, ceramides and retinol.

tech.name: Signature complexes
tech.note: Five forms of hyaluronic acid from low to high molecular weight (toner, emulsion, sun cream); seven types of collagen (white cream, eye cream); ginseng and centella exosomes (ampoule); PDRN and NMN (eye cream, sun cream).

tech.name: In-house R&D
tech.note: A KOITA-recognised research institute develops formulas for hair, scalp and functional skincare, working with Korean universities and ingredient makers.

catalog_notes: A soothing, hydrating toner with 9.8% centella leaf water and five forms of hyaluronic acid, from low to high molecular weight, plus ceramides and peptides. MFDS functional cosmetic for brightening and wrinkle improvement.
A light emulsion that locks in the toner's hydration: centella leaf water, five forms of hyaluronic acid, ceramides and peptides. MFDS functional cosmetic for brightening and wrinkle improvement.

A concentrated gel ampoule with ginseng and centella exosomes (plant extracellular vesicles), ceramides and peptides for a healthy, even complexion. MFDS functional cosmetic for brightening and wrinkle improvement.

A fresh, watery cream with a vitamin complex (C, E, B5 and B3), centella leaf water and ceramides, for elasticity and a brighter tone. MFDS functional cosmetic for brightening and wrinkle improvement.
A rich cream with a complex of seven types of collagen, shea butter and ceramides, for firm, supple, radiant skin. MFDS functional cosmetic for brightening and wrinkle improvement.
An eye cream with seven types of collagen, salmon PDRN, NMN, panthenol and a copper peptide for the delicate skin around the eyes. MFDS functional cosmetic for brightening and wrinkle improvement.

A daily sun cream with four modern UV filters, SPF50+ PA++++, that spreads smoothly without a white cast, with niacinamide, adenosine, hyaluronic acid, PDRN and NMN. MFDS functional cosmetic with three effects: UV protection, brightening and wrinkle improvement. Not water-resistant.
A cleansing shampoo on coconut-derived surfactants with a weakly acidic pH of 5.0–6.0 and cypress essential oil, for the scalp and hair together.
A weakly acidic liquid treatment for oily scalps that controls frizz and dryness and leaves the hair smooth.
A scalp spray in which 81% cypress water replaces ordinary water, with dexpanthenol, L-menthol and salicylic acid; it refreshes the scalp and removes odour. Used once a day.
A rinse-off hair pack with hydrolyzed keratin, silk, collagen and 22 amino acids for damaged hair.
A leave-in balm essence that forms a protective film on hair stressed by colouring, perming and heat styling.
